# nemau_dns_record_set (Resource)

A DNS record set.

`records`, `ttl` and `description` change in place. Changing `name` or `type` forces a replacement.

The zone must be verified: the API refuses record sets on a zone still `PENDING_VERIFICATION`. Set `zone_id` from `nemau_dns_zone_verification.<name>.zone_id` rather than from the zone, so that Terraform waits for the proof before writing records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# zone_id comes from the verification rather than from the zone, so the
# record set is created once the zone is verified.
resource "nemau_dns_record_set" "www" {
  zone_id = nemau_dns_zone_verification.main.zone_id
  name    = "www.example.com."
  type    = "A"
  records = ["203.0.113.10"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Fully qualified record name inside the zone, for example `www.example.com.`. Changing it replaces the record set.
- `records` (List of String) The record values, 1 to 100, one line each. Change in place.
- `type` (String) Record type, such as `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX` or `TXT`. The platform manages `SOA` and the apex `NS` set. Changing it replaces the record set.
- `zone_id` (String) The zone's id. Take it from `nemau_dns_zone_verification.<name>.zone_id` so the record set depends on the verified zone.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description, one line. Changes in place.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds, `300` when not set. Changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The set's id, shaped `canonical.name./TYPE`.
